trans_title: Successor: The Call of the Roots
introduction: Serhat, a successful surgeon defying the fate imposed on him by his homeland, secretly marries the woman he loves, Melek, without his family’s knowledge. However, shortly after, he is forced to return to Urfa and is also compelled to have a religious marriage with Yıldız due to a blood feud between two prominent families in the region.As Serhat transforms from a surgeon into a lord, not only his strength but also his love will face a great test. With Melek's arrival at the mansion, Serhat must confront the secrets brought by the families of both women and their pasts. Because in this mansion, no one is innocent. Everyone has a hidden past, a buried secret...
